label: nothing
what: I cannot establish an undisclosed joint preparation from my experience. Townsfolk reported a bridge or port change discussed at the bakery and named baker, freight, innkeeper and neighbour as present, making them possible participants, not confirmed ones. The neighbour denied personally hearing a crossing discussion, and the secretary reported that the baker knew only rumours. No knowing helpers are identifiable. A bridge or port/crossing change is the only suggested subject; its precise nature and whether any preparation is actually underway remain unconfirmed.
